dossier.headline: Wholesale inflation at 11.39% heads into the October print
dossier.summary: Wholesale inflation jumped to 11.39% in September from 9.92% in August, driven by fuel and power (25.85%), food (8.66%) and a series-high 9.76% for manufactured goods. That came after the RBI's 25 bp hike to 5.50% in October. The October print is due on Monday 16 November, after retail inflation crossed the RBI's 6% ceiling and talk of a December hike gained traction.
